media.title: CapeChain Labs Announces Strategic Partnership with Visa to Power Global Crypto-Fiat Payments on Base L2
media.author: CapeChain Press Office
media.summary: CapeChain Labs joins forces with Visa to launch a co-branded multi-currency debit card, allowing traders to spend crypto and local fiat currencies seamlessly at over 100 million merchants worldwide.
media.content: Today, CapeChain Labs, the creator of the sovereign hybrid exchange platform on Base L2, announced an unprecedented partnership with Visa to deliver next-generation crypto payment solutions across Africa and emerging markets. The CapeChain Visa Card bridges off-chain CEX trading performance with on-chain self-custody, giving users immediate off-ramp liquidity with zero foreign exchange markup.

media.title: CapeChain Closes $18M Series A to Accelerate Pan-African Next-Gen Hybrid Exchange Infrastructure
media.author: Editorial Desk
media.summary: Funding will fuel expansion of fiat liquidity corridors across South Africa (ZAR), Nigeria (NGN), and Kenya (KES), and support hiring for matching engine performance teams.
media.content: CapeChain Labs has raised $18 million in Series A funding led by premier fintech venture firms. The round will accelerate localized banking integrations, regulatory licensing in key African jurisdictions, and developer tooling around account abstraction and ERC-4337 smart accounts.

media.title: Proof-of-Reserves 2.0: CapeChain Introduces Real-Time Merkle Solvency Proofs for Sovereign Custody
media.author: Dr. Aris Thorne, Chief Cryptographer
media.summary: Traders can now verify their account balances in real-time against on-chain Base L2 Vault reserves using cryptographically verified Merkle tree inclusion proofs.
media.content: In an era demanding complete financial transparency, CapeChain Labs sets a new benchmark with its automated Proof-of-Reserves system. By marrying zero-negative balance double-entry ledgers with on-chain cryptographic proofs, traders can independently audit exchange solvency 24/7 without trusting third-party custodians.

media.title: CapeChain Deploys Sub-10µs Deterministic Matching Engine Built in Rust
media.author: Matching Engine Team
media.summary: Achieving over 115,000 orders per second with microsecond latency, CapeChain redefines speed benchmarks for hybrid non-custodial trading.
media.content: CapeChain Labs has published benchmark results for its deterministic order matching engine. Operating entirely in fixed-point integer arithmetic with lock-free memory architectures, the engine guarantees microsecond trade execution while eliminating MEV through Frequent Batch Auction options.
